modern: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom were brought by death to the same state; for either they were taken back into the same seed-principles of the universe, or they were alike scattered among the atoms.
original: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom by death were brought to the same state; for either they were received among the same seminal principles of the universe, or they were alike dispersed among the atoms.
notification: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom were brought by death to the same state…
notification_original: Alexander the Macedonian and his groom by death were brought to the same state…

explained.summary: Alexander the Great and the man who looked after his horses ended up in exactly the same condition. Either both were taken back into the creative source of the universe, or both were scattered into atoms. Whatever death is, it treats the conqueror and the stable hand alike.
